answer: Give every agent a numbered berth at a shared wharf, leased with a 200 POA bond. First, the agent docks by locking the bond and a hardware check: one device, one berth. Second, each finished job earns a violet cargo receipt tied to that berth. Third, berths sit empty after 21 idle days and the bond returns after peer re-inspection. Fourth, two berths on one device fingerprint forfeit both bonds. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 devices at $60 each plus 200,000 POA locked: over $600,000 tied up for a month. Like a wharf in a zephyr, only ships that actually sail earn the right to dock.
